title: How to use Perplexity's Focus modes to get cleaner, faster answers
facebook: Tired of AI answers pulling from everywhere? Perplexity's Focus modes let you pick exactly where it searches — from scholarly papers to your own files — so answers are sharper and come from sources you actually trust. Here's how to use them. https://aiworldhq.com/article/how-to-use-perplexity-s-focus-modes-for-cleaner-answers
